root_cause: P-08.8 made graphSelectionRequest a required ephemeral UI field. Older test fixtures replace the entire ui object with the pre-P-08.8 shape, so nextGraphSelectionRequest dereferenced undefined.version and caused cascade failures.
fix_strategy: Make graphSelectionRequest backwards-compatible in ephemeral state.
Default missing previous request version to 0.
Normalize an omitted graph request inside ReasoningGraph.
Make graph request props optional at component boundaries used by older tests.
Export selectSingleGraphNode from the graph barrel.
Add a migration regression test using the old UI shape.
